Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil is sitting on a chair in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Nikhil: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil stands up.]

Nikhil: "I really enjoyed today."
